findings.highlight: as if something has lifted her upward.
findings.evidenceJa: 何かに掴まれたようにたたらを踏み
findings.governingReading: The source compares her stumble to being grabbed; the parallel intervention branch later identifies arms holding her legs from below.
findings.explanation: Falters as if caught becomes faltering as if lifted upward.

findings.highlight: we shall curse this earth till its death!
findings.evidenceJa: この地上を呪い殺しましょう
findings.governingReading: The source utterance ends before the dying narrator’s final perception at9.
findings.explanation: Caster’s villainous speech lacks its closing quote.

findings.highlight: I feel my body go rigid.
findings.evidenceJa: 身体はモノになっていく。
findings.governingReading: As Shirou dies, his body becomes a mere thing, expressing the loss of its living, personal status.
findings.explanation: His body becoming a mere thing becomes his body stiffening. The death scene remains, but its explicit loss of personhood is replaced by a physical symptom.
